guards_arrive.note: Guards of Varenholt come looking for the girl. The hero refuses to give her up; the fight is ordinary combat, begun on the last beat.

beats.text: The barking stops all at once. In the silence there are boots, a great many of them, and the creak of leather.
A fist hammers on the door of the inn. The innkeeper looks at you, and does not move.
The door is thrown open. Red cloaks fill the doorway: a sergeant, and two guards of Varenholt with their hands on their swords.
[[YELLOW]]Sergeant Havel speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Captain. Or whatever you are now. Varenholt has been looking for you."[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Sergeant Havel speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"The king wants the girl. The summoner's brat. Give her up, and you can walk out of here. Nobody needs to say you ran."[[/]]
You stand. Your hand finds the hilt of the dark blade, and stays there. [[BLUE]]"She is a child. She stays with me."[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Sergeant Havel speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Then it is desertion, and treason, and I am sorry for it, Captain. I mean that. Take him alive, if you can."[[/]]
[[RED]]Three blades come out of three scabbards at once.[[/]]

after_the_guards.note: The guards are beaten: the innkeeper, Ryn waking and choosing to come along, and a word about a woman asking for the hero.

beats.text: The last guard goes down, and the inn is quiet but for your breathing and the shutters rattling in the wind.
The innkeeper comes out from behind the counter, grey in the face, a heavy pan still in one hand. She looks at the floor, and then at you.
[[YELLOW]]The innkeeper speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Twenty years I have kept this room, and nobody has ever drawn steel in it. Go on. See to the girl. I will see to the floor."[[/]]
A small sound from the back room. Ryn is sitting up on the pallet, her face the colour of ash, staring through the curtain at what is on the floor.
[[YELLOW]]Ryn speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"You stood in front of them. I heard all of it, through the wall."[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Ryn speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"They were going to take me back to him. Weren't they."[[/]]
[[BLUE]]"Not while I am standing."[[/]] You wipe the blade, and mean it.
[[YELLOW]]Ryn speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Mother is gone. The village is gone. I have nowhere left to go."[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Ryn speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"If you will have me, I would rather go where you go. And I can help. Mother taught me more than the calling."[[/]]

[[YELLOW]]The innkeeper speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"If you are the dark-bladed captain from the king's city, there is something you should know. A woman came in off the Saltreach road three nights ago, half out of her mind with fever. She keeps asking for a man with a black sword. Old Orrin and Maren took her in. Their house has blue shutters."[[/]]

sickroom_visit.note: The first time the hero goes into the back room of Orrin and Maren's house: Rosalind, sick with salt fever, and what it will take to cure her.

beats.text: The back room is dim, and smells of vinegar and crushed herbs. An old man stands beside a narrow bed, and does not look round as you come in.
Someone is lying in it. Even in the half-dark, grey and shining with fever, you know the line of her face.
Rosalind.
[[YELLOW]]Rosalind speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Is that... you? You came. No... I came. I came to find you."[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Rosalind speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"They said the ships had gone south. I took the road. And then the whole mountain came down."[[/]]
[[BLUE]]"Rest. I am here."[[/]] Her hand finds yours, hot as a stone left in the sun, and holds on.
[[YELLOW]]Orrin speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"We found her at the edge of the wash three nights back, half buried, talking about a man with a black sword. Maren has not left her side since."[[/]]

[[YELLOW]]Orrin speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"It is the salt fever. It comes up out of the wash in the hot months and it does not let go. She will not see the month out. Not unless you can fetch a mirage pearl."[[/]]
[[BLUE]]"Where?"[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Orrin speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Ask me. There is more to tell, and she should sleep."[[/]] (talk orrin)

rosalind_cured.note: The mirage pearl is given to Orrin; the fever breaks.

beats.text: Orrin crushes the pearl into the cup, and Maren holds it to Rosalind's lips. Nobody breathes.
For a long time nothing happens. Then, slowly, the shine goes out of her face, the way frost goes off a field.
[[YELLOW]]Rosalind speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"...You look terrible."[[/]]
[[BLUE]]"You look better."[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Rosalind speaks:[[/]] [[GREEN]]"Stay out of trouble until I can stand. That is an order."[[/]]
